Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md phases 4-6 for timing of issue checks, post-review coverage and final precommit gate. Request final human approval only after the final gate passes. This epic does not authorize commits/pushes/merges. Keep epic open until all acceptance and validation work is complete.

E2E: no new UI or user journey; unit, property and thin integration tests provide the required coverage. Reassess if scope changes.
